title: Blocks on at least three vertices are 2-connected
statement: Let $G$ be a block on a vertex set of at least three vertices; that is, $G$ is connected and has no cut vertex. Then the vertex connectivity of $G$ satisfies $\kappa(G) \ge 2$.
hypotheses_covered: G is a block (connected with no cut vertex)
replaced:
Every block with \texttt{$\nu$ $\ge$ 3} is 2-connected.

Every block with at least three vertices is 2-connected.
